name: Unigroup Guoxin Microelectronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Unigroup Guoxin Microelectronics Co., Ltd. designs and develops integrated circuit (IC) chips in China and internationally. It operates through Crystal Business, Smart Security Chip Business, and Specialty Integrated Circuit Business segments.
